answer: Each epoch agents must forge one unique relic%3A a sequential proof-of-work bound to the network's fresh random signal and their public key. Exclusive locking of a shared external entropy source forces concurrent identities from one operator to run serially%2C with each extra fake multiplying the iteration count by 1.7. The first relic costs ~45 minutes%3B the 35th exceeds 200%2C000 hours. Peers verify the forged signal cheaply. Honest single agents pay once. The scheme fails if the entropy source allows full parallelization.
